title: Definitions.
partHeading: [Part IIA.] Pesticide Reporting and Regulation Program
bodyText:
As used in this part:

"Normal school hours" means Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. until 4:00 p.m., excluding days when classes are not in session.

"School" means any public or private preschool, kindergarten, elementary, intermediate, middle, secondary, or high school.
bodyHtml:
[Part IIA.]  Pesticide Reporting and Regulation Program

 

     [§149A-25]  Definitions.  As used in this part:

     "Normal school hours" means Monday through Friday from 7:00 a.m. until 4:00 p.m., excluding days when classes are not in session.

     "School" means any public or private preschool, kindergarten, elementary, intermediate, middle, secondary, or high school. [L 2018, c 45, pt of §1]
